name: Klaus-Dieter Adler
bio:
Klaus-Dieter Adler's journey in motorsport began in his youth, fueled by a deep fascination with engineering and racing. He started as a volunteer mechanic at local karting events, quickly demonstrating an aptitude for problem-solving and a meticulous attention to detail. His passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, after which he joined Manthey Racing as a junior engineer. Over the years, he progressively climbed the ranks, proving himself as a capable strategist and leader. 

As Team Principal, Klaus-Dieter is known for his data-driven approach and his commitment to fostering a culture of continuous improvement. He believes in empowering his team members, encouraging them to experiment and push the boundaries of innovation. While he values collaboration, he also trusts his own instincts and is not afraid to make bold decisions when necessary. His vision for Manthey Racing is to be at the forefront of motorsport technology and to consistently challenge for championships.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed to the side with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Klaus-Dieter is a man of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of German mineral water available at all times.
